Cannot reproduce on v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]. Animation "test" plays after switching to the "crash_test" scene without a crash.

> Cannot reproduce on v4.7.1.stable.official [[a13da4f](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/a13da4feb8d8aefc283c3763d33a2f170a18d541)]. Animation "test" plays after switching to the "crash_test" scene without a crash.

Indeed, this was fixed on 4.6 dev2 by commit cf65c18817831618cfc0095514af9f4b60eb7ee9 from PR #103416. Thanks for pointing out.
